enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Adjust pillow. Lie on back. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Remain still.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands and turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light and walk out.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard and take out bowl, plate, glass. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Pour eggs into pan and stir. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster and butter. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes, rinse, and place in dishwasher. Wipe counter, turn off light, and walk out.

Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room and change into uniform.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at station. Clock in. Review patient charts. Attend morning meeting. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Update patient records. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Assist patient with mobility. Walk to nurse station. Consult with colleague. Answer phone. Document notes. Take break and eat lunch.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cupboard and take out pots, pans, plates. Close cupboard. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Chop vegetables. Cook vegetables in pan and stir. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear dishes, rinse, and place in dishwasher. Wipe counter, turn off light, and walk out.

Enter living room. Turn on light. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Open snack. Eat snack and watch TV.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Scroll. Watch video. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Open email. Read email. Reply to email. Close browser. Turn off computer. Stand up. Turn off light.

Enter living room. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust sitting position. Put book down. Stand up. Get glass of water. Return. Sit down. Pick up book. Continue reading. Turn page. Close book. Stand up. Place book on shelf.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Fold clothes. Place clothes on chair. Pull back blanket. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Check messages. Set alarm. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to other side. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Remain still. Pull blanket up.
